title: 第14章 朕回去自罚三杯
novel_title: 九恶妃每日一问，陛下驾崩了吗？
content_zh:
洪烈目光落寞地立在原地。

    虎躯中像是被抽空了力气。

    作为征战沙场的老兵，这点伤痛对他来说，如同挠痒痒。

    但心中的绝望和无奈，却如同一根根尖刀，撕刮着他的血肉。

    曾经鼎盛的大夏，随着先帝的阵亡以及云家族人的陨落，如今和他这条无助的老狗一般，垂垂老矣任人欺凌。

    随便一个人都能踹上两脚。

    大夏神朝下属地域万万里，曾统御过亿万子民，盛极一时。

    现在，属于大夏神朝的时代，终是要落幕了吗……

    许典恭敬地站在唐梦辰身侧。

    “这点小插曲，请唐二公子不要在意，属下这就带您进入宝库。”

    唐梦辰瞥了洪烈一眼，脸上的讥讽之色毫不掩饰。

    “看到了吗？有些事，即便你不做，也会有别人争着做的……不懂事的东西。”

    “呦，这里挺热闹啊。”

    许典正要带着唐梦辰往前走，一道慵懒的声音响了起来。

    近百个太监侍卫开路，龙辇缓缓行进，一个衣着镶金白龙袍的翩翩虚公子潇洒而来。

    洪烈扫了一眼来者，轻叹口气便移开了目光。

    许典略有惊慌。

    唐梦辰并无太多反应。

    “你不用慌，有本公子在，自会保你周全。”

    他那张桀骜的脸上，不仅没有害怕之色，反而带着一丝若有若无的优越感。

    眼前的废物皇帝，只是自己姐姐的舔狗罢了……

    龙辇来到近前。

    秦然打着哈欠，在青符的搀扶下，脚步不稳地跳了下去。

    身形一晃，差点摔了一跤。

    “狗奴才，怎么扶的朕！”

    秦然一脚踹在了青符身上，后者脸色微变，不敢有任何表现。

    唐梦辰嘴角的戏谑之意更浓。

    “呦，陛下来了，你来的正好，我替姐姐来宝库取几样东西，这些狗奴才却拦着不让进，你快让他们开门，姐姐还等着呢。”

    “自家人，好说好说。”

    秦然打着哈哈，扫了眼洪烈，最后目光落在了许典身上。

    “你叫什么名字。”

    许典下意识看了唐梦辰一眼。

    唐梦辰一笑，“陛下问你话呢，你看本公子做什么。”

    许典闻声，赶忙躬身行礼。

    “回禀陛下，臣名许典，职位禁卫千夫长，负责统御皇宫宝库。”

    秦然点点头，热切地搂住了许典的肩膀。

    “哦，原来是许统领啊。”

    洪烈见此一幕，深深低下了头。

    心中的绝望已经将他整个人淹没。

    许典暗暗松了口气。

    秦然指了指洪烈，随口道：“他身上的伤，是你教训的？”
content_en:
Hong Lie stood there with a lonely look.

The strength seemed to have been drained from the tiger's body.

As a veteran of the battlefield, this pain was like scratching an itch for him.

But the despair and helplessness in his heart were like a sharp knife, tearing at his flesh and blood.

The once prosperous Daxia, with the death of the late emperor and the fall of the Yun family, is now like a helpless old dog like him, aging and being bullied.

Anyone can be kicked in the face.

The Great Xia Divine Dynasty covered an area of ​​tens of thousands of miles, and once ruled hundreds of millions of people. It was very prosperous for a while.

Now, is the era of the Great Xia Dynasty finally coming to an end...

Xu Dian stood respectfully beside Tang Mengchen.

"Second Master Tang, please don't pay attention to this little incident. I will take you into the treasure house right now."

Tang Mengchen glanced at Hong Lie, the sarcasm on his face undisguised.

"Did you see it? There are some things that even if you don't do them, others will be vying to do them... ignorant things."

"Hey, it's quite lively here."

Xu Dian was about to lead Tang Mengchen forward when a lazy voice rang out.

Nearly a hundred eunuchs and guards opened the way, the dragon chariot marched slowly, and a graceful young master in gold-embellished white dragon robes came elegantly.

Hong Lie glanced at the visitor, sighed and looked away.

Xu Dian was slightly panicked.

Tang Mengchen didn't have much reaction.

"You don't need to panic. I'm here and I will keep you safe."

His unruly face showed not only no fear, but a hint of superiority.

The good-for-nothing emperor in front of me is just my sister’s licking dog...

The dragon chariot came closer.

Qin Ran yawned and jumped down unsteadily with Qing Fu's support.

His body swayed and he almost fell.

"You dog slave, how could you help me!"

Qin Ran kicked Qing Fu, who's face changed slightly and he didn't dare to show anything.

The corners of Tang Mengchen's mouth became even more playful.

"Hey, Your Majesty is here. You came just in time. I came to the treasure house to get a few things for my sister, but these dog slaves are blocking my way. Please let them open the door quickly. My sister is still waiting."

"My family is easy to talk to."

Qin Ran laughed, glanced at Hong Lie, and finally his eyes fell on Xu Dian.

"What's your name?"

Xu Dian glanced at Tang Mengchen subconsciously.

Tang Mengchen smiled and said, "Your Majesty is asking you something. What do you think this young master will do?"

Xu Dian heard the sound and quickly bowed to salute.

"Reporting to Your Majesty, my name is Xu Dian, my position is Captain of the Imperial Guard, and I am responsible for controlling the palace treasury."

Qin Ran nodded and hugged Xu Dian's shoulders eagerly.

"Oh, it turns out to be Commander Xu."

Seeing this scene, Hong Lie lowered his head deeply.

The despair in his heart had overwhelmed him.

Xu Dian secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

Qin Ran pointed at Hong Lie and said casually: "Did you teach him a lesson for the injuries on his body?"
